summary: BI-9EC60FE0 (slice 3 of EP-PORTFOLIO-BUDGET-WIP). New model PortfolioBudgetPeriod: one portfolio's investment budget for one calendar quarter, in points, with an optional $ rate per point and an optional WIP allowance override. Written only by set_portfolio_budget, which requires a person and a reason. Rows are never edited; a change inserts a row that supersedes the current one (supersedesId unique, and one chain root per portfolio and period), so the chain is the audit trail and exactly one row is current. A portfolio with no row has no budget set. Portfolio.budgetKUsd is unchanged and remains the annual financial figure. Additive: a new empty table and no backfill. Migration: 20260925190000_portfolio_budget_period.

fields.name: portfolioId
fields.reason: The portfolio the budget belongs to; cascades with the portfolio.
fields.provenance: Chosen by the setting person from the portfolios the proposal lists.

fields.name: periodStart
fields.reason: Start of the UTC calendar quarter the budget covers; budgets are quarterly by founder decision (2026-09-24).
fields.provenance: Derived server-side from the requested date; the write refuses anything but a whole quarter.

fields.name: allocatedPoints
fields.reason: The budget in investment points, the unit reservations, admission and the tie-out share.
fields.provenance: Operator-entered, normally accepting or editing propose_portfolio_budgets.

fields.name: usdPerPoint
fields.reason: Optional price of a point for the quarter; the tie-out shows points x rate beside budgetKUsd. It never changes what is stored in points.

fields.name: wipAllowancePoints
fields.reason: Optional override of the points-in-flight allowance the admission rule (slice 6) otherwise derives from throughput.

fields.name: setById
fields.reason: The person who set the budget; the design allows no budget without an attributable actor.
fields.provenance: From the authenticated caller; never client-supplied.

fields.name: setByAgentId
fields.reason: The AI coworker that carried the change for the person, when it is a registered agent.

fields.name: reason
fields.reason: Why the budget is right; required so every row explains itself.

fields.name: supersedesId
fields.reason: The row this one replaces; with the unique indexes it keeps one linear history per portfolio and quarter.
fields.provenance: Set server-side to the current row at write time.
